<description>
Enable IPC on 32-bit x86. It was chosen arbitrarily in #31802 to have coverage for `-DENABLE_IPC=OFF`, but this was not a good choice given issues like:
- https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/383

I could not find a good candidate CI configuration to disable IPC.

It's still disabled on Windows, until #32387. It's also disabled on RISC-V.
</description>
